groups.name: usb_power
groups.why: power entry and conditioning: USB-C J1 with its CC 5k1 pull-downs (R52/R53), shield RC (C13/R3), VBUS ferrite FB1 and cap C8, the TPD3S014 VBUS switch + D+/D- ESD U15 (its +5V output feeds everything), the 3V3 LDO U8 and 1V2 LDO U36 with their in/out caps, the +5V supervisor U7, the +5V bulk C87; C1 (declared pose, +3V3 4u7) is the 3V3 output cap and anchors the LDOs; the rail and USB test points go with the nets they probe

groups.name: core
groups.why: the FPGA U30 (iCE40HX8K BGA-121) and the FX2 USB controller U1 that talk over a 27-net bus, one core: U1's 24 MHz crystal Y1 with load caps C11/C12, the FX2 reset RC R4/R5/C88 and its OR diode D24, FPGA_RESET pull-down R9, ALERT pull-up R17, the CLKREF/CLKIF test points, every root-sheet +3V3 and +1V2 decap of the two chips, the PLL filters (R31/C76/C78, R32/C79/C80), the VIO_AUX caps (C33 at U30's bank-3 balls), and J5 (declared pose) whose 13 LVDS pairs land on U30 directly

groups.name: leds
groups.why: indicator LEDs with their series resistors: D1 power (R12 from +3V3), D2-D5 FX2 status (LED_CY/FPGA/ACT/ERR), D6-D10 FPGA user LEDs (U1..U5); each LED moves with its resistor

groups.name: bank_a
groups.why: I/O port A: IDC header J2 (declared pose) with its ESD arrays D22/D23 and VSENSE TVS D17, the 8 SN74LVC1T45 level shifters with their 33R series arrays (RN7/RN8 FPGA side, RN9/RN10 port side), the PCA6408 expander U19 driving the 10k pull arrays RN11/RN12, the DNP test sockets J8/J9, and the shifters' and U19's +3V3 and VIOA decaps (B side, under the shifters)

groups.name: bank_a_pwr
groups.why: port A's VIO supply: adjustable LDO U31 (+5V in, C82/C59) through R56/R49 sense shunts to VIOA (C83), INA233 monitor U21 with its 4R7 filter R30/R54/C58 and VSENSE filter R60/C91, DAC U20 setting the LDO feedback (R33/R34/R35), enable R55 + pull-down R18 + alert diode D19, the port-power LED D15/R47

groups.name: bank_b
groups.why: I/O port B, the same as port A: IDC J3 (declared pose), ESD D20/D21, TVS D16, 8 level shifters U22-U29 with RN1/RN2 and RN3/RN4, expander U5 with pull arrays RN5/RN6, DNP sockets J6/J7, their decaps

groups.name: bank_b_pwr
groups.why: port B's VIO supply, the same as port A's: LDO U14, shunts R7/R48, INA233 U12, DAC U13 + feedback divider, enable/pull-down/alert, LED D14/R46

groups.name: sync_aux
groups.why: SYNC port J4 (declared pose) with its level shifter U32 and decap C85, 47R series R38/R45, pull-up R44, ESD D11, direction pull-down R10; AUX header J10 with 47R series R39/R43 and ESD D12/D13 to the FPGA

groups.name: eeprom_i2c
groups.why: the two I2C EEPROMs (declared poses with their declared decaps C15/C17), U3's DNP address strap R40, the I2C pull-ups R1/R2 at the EEPROM end of the bus, SDA/SCL test points

groups.name: reset_btn
groups.why: the reset button (seated at the south-edge notch) and its MR debounce cap
